notes.title: Patch 1.3.5
notes.content:
[h1]Updated for Steam Controllers![/h1]

[b]Steam Controllers now fully supported, allowing ultra precise analog movements. Customize the basic profile in big picture mode![/b]
[list]
[*]Joysticks now use full analog input.
[*]Angular movement calculations improved.
[*]Main menu and customization screens accessible with joystick.
[*]Deadzones adjusted.
[/list]

tags.feature: Steam Controllers now fully supported, allowing ultra precise analog movements. Customize the basic profile in big picture mode!

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0
notes.content:
[h1]Weapon Updates:[/h1]

[b]Secondary weapons now have additional scaling effects for late game effectiveness![/b]
New scaling effects of each weapon are as follows:
[list]
[*] Rainbow Cannon: Size
[*] Gatling Gun: Spread
[*] Drones: Duration
[*] Static Generator: Arcs
[/list]

[h1]Settings:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added option to toggle VSync.
[*] Added option to reduce particle effects. (Most notably the smoke!)
[*] Tied anti-aliasing to quality setting.
[/list]

[h1]General Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Screenshots now work properly!
[*] Fixed audio cutting out at high laser levels.
[*] File structure improved. SSDs rejoice!
[/list]

tags.balance_change: [b]Secondary weapons now have additional scaling effects for late game effectiveness![/b]

tags.feature: [*] Added option to reduce particle effects. (Most notably the smoke!)

tags.bug: [*] Fixed audio cutting out at high laser levels.
